checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 3.7% vs its 20-SMA, 5.2% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 2 of 3 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The prior leg is a clean, persistent staircase from ~$185 to ~$270 over 60 sessions with high R² linearity, and the 4-session base is tight with minimal giveback. However, the trend is visibly mature — the chart shows repeated pushes higher since late June with multiple consolidation-and-burst cycles visible in the last three months, and the move is now 42% off its start, raising the risk that this is a later-stage push rather than a fresh breakout. The burst bar itself is honest (closed near the high, above open, modest gap), but the volume rank of 8 out of 60 and base volume running above the leg average (1.72x) are soft spots that keep this from A quality.
claude.key_risk: A 60-session, 45% move with multiple prior breakouts visible on the chart means late-trend exhaustion is the primary risk; any broad market softness could accelerate a reversal.
claude.entry_note: Skip if IQV opens below the burst close of 275.02 or gaps up more than 1.5% above it without follow-through in the first 30 minutes.
